top of page
Vote andrew Barnes for Menlo Park City school Board
Strong Schools.
Responsive Leadership.
My family has benefited tremendously from the Menlo Park City School District. I'm running for School Board to support our district that shaped my son and so many other students.
I'm Chair of the Measure U Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee. I have years of professional experience working in county government managing public projects and taxpayer funds. I can help navigate the tough decisions on priorities, budgets, and long-range planning.
I'm dedicated to actively meeting with parents and our wider community to bring input, questions, and concerns back to the district for discussion. For example, what is the right amount of technology in the classroom? Which priorities should our district fund, and why?
I'll build on what makes our school district successful and ensure that we remain a district where students, families, and staff have the best opportunity to learn and grow.
​
I respectfully ask for your vote.
## Why
I'm
Running
# Meet
Andrew
​Current
Measure U Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee, Chair
Past
​Housing Element Advisory Team
Full Funding Advisory Committee
Menlo Park Planning Commissioner, 2016-2024, Chair
Menlo Park Environmental Quality Commissioner
Menlo Park Transportation Master Plan Oversight Committee
My son attended Laurel Elementary and Hillview Middle School and is now a freshman at Menlo-Atherton High School. Watching him grow in the school district, including in the Spanish Immersion program, gave me a firsthand appreciation for the teachers, staff, and community that make it such a special place.
My Professional Experience
I work in facilities and real estate for the County of Santa Clara's Facilities and Fleet Department, managing public facilities and public financed improvements across more than 110 sites. My work requires balancing stakeholder priorities, managing limited budgets, and making difficult decisions about allocating resources.
My Community Work
The Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee for Measure U is charged with ensuring accountability for the school district's $130 million voter-approved bond funding facility improvements at Hillview, Oak Knoll, Encinal, and Laurel.
I want to ensure that future students have the same opportunities that my son enjoyed.
​
##### Strong Academics
Support the teachers, programs, and learning environments that make our district exceptional.
#### Future Planning
Bring practical public sector experience to stakeholder engagement, needs assessments, and long-range planning.
#### Fiscal Responsibility
Thoughtfully evaluate programs and related expenditures. Responsibly manage public funds and operating budgets.
## My Priorities
### Student Well-Being
Help ensure that all our students feel safe, supported, and, most importantly, seen for who they are.
## Community Support and Endorsements
I'm grateful for the support from my fellow community members.
Lisa Gauthier
San Mateo County Supervisor
“With his years of professional experience working in county government and his public service on both county and city commissions, Andrew really understands how to be effective in public office.”
David Canepa
San Mateo County Supervisor
Stacey Jones
Former Menlo Park City School District trustee
Darren Ewaniuk
MPCSD Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee
"I've seen firsthand how seriously he takes his responsibility to the district's families and taxpayers. He brings his collaborative, straightforward, and highly optimistic approach to every discussion."
### CK
MPCSD Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee
Chris Koranda
"I can't think of a better candidate for the School Board—as Chairman, he is organized, prepared, thoughtful, and always efficient in making sure the CBOC serves the community's interests. "
"I’ve seen Andrew in action across his many roles, and I’m always impressed by his thoughtfulness. He fully understands a complicated issue before making any decision."
Jory Macdonald
Former Hillview PTO treasurer and Laurel PTO president
Vamsi Velagapudi
MPCSD Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee / Menlo Park Audit and finance Committee
"Twice chosen to chair the Bond Oversight Committee, Andrew is a respected leader. He's got the skills to lead the School Board on critical budget and long-range planning decisions."
"I've relied on Andrew's expertise countless times for guidance on materializing bike safety improvements. He knows the system, he's a bike safety advocate, and he's always there with actionable advice. "
Christy Peetz
Safe Routes to School - Frmr Hillview and Laurel Liaison
"It was a privilege to serve alongside Andrew. He'll bring the same deep engagement to decision-making, problem-solving, and community building to the School Board."
LinhDan Do
